mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code AND wm.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pm.is_deleted = FALSE AND ptm.task_status = #{approveStatus} AND ptm.cur_approve_id = #{userId} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify

SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code AND wm.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pm.is_deleted = FALSE AND (ptm.task_status = #{approveStatus} OR ptm.task_status = 'reject') AND ptm.cur_approve_id = #{userId} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify

SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm LEFT JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code AND wm.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pm.is_deleted = FALSE AND ptm.create_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify

SELECT count(*) AS quantity, wm.sys_classify FROM process_management pm INNER JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN work_menu wm ON pm.business_key = wm.module_code AND wm.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN process_task_cc cc ON cc.task_management_id = ptm.id AND ptm.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pm.is_deleted = FALSE AND cc.cc_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY wm.sys_classify
